answers.stop_study: Yes, please run the -50% stop and 'underlying back to the entry price' variants on your 2024-02 0DTE sample; we will run the same two on our 13 snipers + 6 intraday picks plus the scanner universe (SUNDAY_TESTS item 37) and compare.
